E4Plus1.uk.description: The Kremps: Beverly bombards her reserved neighbours with invitations to a barbecue. Barry and Erica battle for control of the phone. (S1 Ep8)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: Stop Arguing and Start Thanking: When Beverly invites Murray's unreliable brother Marvin to visit at Thanksgiving, she re-ignites their long-standing feud. (S1 Ep9)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Don't Tell the Bride: Revisited
E4Plus1.uk.description: High-flying groom Kev sits down with his bride Trish to remember one of the most turbulent weddings in Don't Tell the Bride history. (Ep3)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Hawaii: A relaxing family vacation in Hawaii gets slightly derailed when everyone has their own ideas of fun. (S1 Ep23)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Family Portrait: It's family picture day and everything that can go wrong, does. (S1 Ep24)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Rude(ish) Tube Shorts
E4Plus1.uk.description: A short, cheeky clip from Rude Tube's naughty little sister, Rude(ish) Tube, featuring sports of the lawnmower, motorbike and bicycle variety.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
E4Plus1.uk.description: In Blackpool, ex-dancer Rowan and businessman John take on hard-to-please Holly and Ollie, and Sally and Joanne, who wear matching tie-dye, in a week featuring a belly-busting breakfast.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Gordon Ramsay revisits four restaurants he tried to help: the Spanish Pavillion in New Jersey, and Kingston Café, La Frite and Capri in California. (S5 Ep17) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Mill Street Bistro (Part 1/2): The owner of the Mill Street Bistro in Ohio claims to have the best menu between New York and LA. But the diners don't agree. (S6 Ep12)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Married at First Sight USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: The couples 'celebrate' their one-month anniversaries, and some of them can't quite believe it's only been one month and not an eternity... (S9 Ep8)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Vegas: The adults are Vegas-bound when Jay hooks them up with Excelsior Level hotel accommodation, courtesy of one of his big clients. (S5 Ep18)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: A Hard Jay's Night: Mitch struggles to hide his true feelings about the unflattering wedding topper that Cam's father whittled out of soap for them. (S5 Ep19)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Dad Who Knew Too Little: Homer hires a detective to spy on Lisa so he can get to know her better. But when Homer doesn't pay him, the detective frames Lisa for a crime. (S14 Ep8/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Pray Anything: Jealous of Flanders' lifestyle, Homer starts to pray for material possessions, but things get out of hand when he asks for a bigger house and gets the church. (S14 Ep10/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Barting Over: Bart moves into a downtown apartment of his own, and befriends famous skateboarder Tony Hawk (guest starring as himself). Also guest starring Blink-182. (S14 Ep11/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: I'm Spelling as Fast as I Can: Lisa wins a place at the Spellympics National Spelling Bee but discovers that it's not as clean-cut a competition as she thought. (S14 Ep12/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: Full Boyle: Boyle's new romance increases his self-confidence, Diaz and Santiago can't take a costumed crime-fighter seriously, and Holt faces a leadership challenge. (S1 Ep17)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Apartment: Peralta is in danger of losing his flat but has no money to buy his own place, so Gina tries to help him find a new home. The officers do self-evaluations. (S1 Ep18)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Valentine's Day 4: Twisted Sister: On Valentine's Day, Claire is worried that Phil may be more into her alter-ego Juliana than her. (S6 Ep14)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Fight or Flight: After a reunion weekend with Phil's old buddies, Claire jumps at the chance to snag the only first-class seat left on the flight home, leaving Phil in coach. (S6 Ep15)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Connection Lost: Claire's computer becomes the hub of all the family's activities when she gets stuck at the airport and is desperate to reach Haley after a big fight. (S6 Ep16)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Closet? You'll Love It!: Jay and Claire scramble to shoot a Pritchett Closets commercial in response to their competitor's new advert, but there might be some creative conflict. (S6 Ep17)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Burns and the Bees: Mr Burns wins a basketball team in a game of poker, then decides to build a stadium on top of Lisa's bee colony. (S20 Ep8/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Lisa the Drama Queen: Lisa and her new friend Juliet (Emily Blunt) create a fantasy world that takes them a bit too far from reality. (S20 Ep9/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Take My Life, Please: Homer is annoyed when his old high school nemesis Vance Connor gets a spot on the Springfield Walk of Fame. (S20 Ep10/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: How the Test Was Won: When Bart gets top marks in a test, Lisa's so shocked that she freezes in her exam. Homer desperately avoids danger after failing to renew his insurance. (S20 Ep11/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Margical Mystery Tour: The Springfield Library doesn't have enough books to help with the kids' research papers, so Marge steps in with some anecdotes on historical figures. (S15 Ep11/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brother from the Same Planet: When Homer is late picking up Bart from a school football game, Bart gets a surrogate dad from an agency. (S4 Ep14/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Married at First Sight USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: A lie spirals into a gigantic conflict for one couple. And with revelations happening left, right and centre, all of the relationships change irreversibly. (S9 Ep9)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Celebs Go Dating
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: David questions whether Anthony has doubts, PK attempts to show a different side to his character, and Stephen decides whether to see Claira again, or not. (S15 Ep19/20)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Goggleboxers watch the Queen's funeral, The Masked Dancer, Frozen Planet II, Bad Sisters, The Grand Tour: A Scandi Flick and Secret Crush. (S20 Ep3)
